# `prefab` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "prefab" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/prefab/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required |  |
| `name` | string | required | Display name in the catalogue. |
| `description` | string | required | What it is for and how a designer uses it. |
| `tags` | list of id | `[]` | Catalogue tags: light, weight, water… |
| `parameters` | map of string → object | `{}` | Parameters an instance may set; one without a default must be given. |
| `parameters.<key>.type` | `"number"` | required |  |
| `parameters.<key>.description` | string | required | What the parameter does, for the catalogue. |
| `parameters.<key>.unit` | string | — | Unit of the value, e.g. kg, m, s, degrees. |
| `parameters.<key>.min` | number | — | Least value allowed. |
| `parameters.<key>.max` | number | — | Greatest value allowed. |
| `parameters.<key>.default` | number | — | Value when an instance leaves it out; none = required. |
| `parameters.<key>.example` | any | — | A value used when the prefab is checked and the parameter has no default. |
| `parameters.<key>.type` | `"integer"` | required |  |
| `parameters.<key>.min` | integer | — | Least value allowed. |
| `parameters.<key>.max` | integer | — | Greatest value allowed. |
| `parameters.<key>.default` | integer | — | Value when an instance leaves it out; none = required. |
| `parameters.<key>.type` | `"boolean"` | required |  |
| `parameters.<key>.default` | boolean | — | Value when an instance leaves it out; none = required. |
| `parameters.<key>.type` | `"enum"` | required |  |
| `parameters.<key>.values` | list of string (at least 2) | required | The values it may take. |
| `parameters.<key>.default` | string | — | Value when an instance leaves it out; none = required. |
| `spawns` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The spawns it places, relative to the instance. |
| `spawns[].local` | id | required | Name of the spawn within the prefab; the instance prefixes it. |
| `graph` | object | — | Its own behaviour, as a signal graph bound to its spawns by their local names (placed with the instance’s id as the graph id). |
| `graph.nodes` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Signal graph nodes (any signal-graph node). |
| `graph.nodes[].id` | id | required |  |
| `graph.nodes[].kind` | string | required |  |
| `graph.wires` | list of object | required | Connections, as in a signal graph. |
| `graph.wires[].from` | string | required |  |
| `graph.wires[].to` | string | required |  |
| `inputs` | list of object | `[]` | What can drive it, for the catalogue. |
| `inputs[].name` | id | required | What the input is called in the catalogue. |
| `inputs[].description` | string | required | What drives it and what it does. |
| `inputs[].spawn` | id | required | The spawn of the prefab that takes it (a signal graph binds it). |
| `outputs` | list of object (at least 1) | required | What it tells the rest of the puzzle: signals, properties, states. |
| `outputs[].name` | id | required | What the output is called in the catalogue. |
| `outputs[].description` | string | required | When it is on, in a designer’s words. |
| `outputs[].node` | id | — | A node of the prefab’s graph: the signal "<instance>/<node>" a goal or graph reads. |
| `outputs[].spawn` | id | — | A spawn of the prefab: the entity itself (a goal reads where it is, a tag, or `property`). |
| `outputs[].property` | string | — | With `spawn`: the world property of that spawn the output reads. |
